units.source_text: 此时随从人等一个也不曾起身。

en.t: At this time, not one of the attendants had yet risen.

units.source_text: 源氏公子躺着独自反复讽咏。

en.t: Prince Genji lay there alone, repeatedly chanting verses to himself.

units.source_text: 天色未明，即起身洗手，念佛诵经。

en.t: Before dawn had broken, he got up, washed his hands, invoked the Buddha, and recited sutras.

units.source_text: 随从人等看了，回想公子以前从未如此谨饬，

en.t: Seeing this, the attendants recalled that the prince had never before been so disciplined and devout,

units.source_text: 便觉深可敬爱，没有一个人肯离开他。

en.t: and they felt even deeper reverence and affection for him; not one of them was willing to leave his side.

units.source_text: 即使暂时，也不想回京中的私宅去。

en.t: Even for a short while, they did not want to return to their private homes in the capital.
